17: Summary of New Zealand labour force projections
51: Percentiles indicate the probability that the actual result is lower than this percentile. For example, the 25th percentile indicates a 25 percent
52: probability that the actual result for a given year is lower than this percentile.
66: Note: Owing to rounding, individual figures may not sum to give the stated totals.
67: Percentiles are non-additive except the 50th percentile (median). For example, percentiles for the labour force aged 15–39 and 40–64 years
68: cannot be added together to give the equivalent percentile for the labour force aged 15–64 years.
